CVE-2026-103931.title: Instatic: Stored XSS
CVE-2026-103931.description: Instatic is an open source visual content management system for building static websites. Prior to 0.0.14, isSafeUrl() and safeUrl() in src/core/html-sanitize/index.ts remove tabs, newlines, carriage returns, and characters handled by String.prototype.trim(), but leave other leading C0 control characters that browsers discard before parsing a URL scheme. A low-privileged editor can place a dangerous URL behind one of those controls in a URL property or custom HTML attribute, allowing src/core/publisher/escapeProps.ts and the shared URL sanitizer to emit it into rendered content. When an Owner or Admin activates the element in the same-origin admin editor canvas, script executes with the victim's application authority and can drive admin APIs to read protected data, create an owner account, or install a plugin. This issue is fixed in version 0.0.14.

CVE-2026-125337.title: Winter CMS: ImportExportController AJAX handlers bypass granular import/export permission gate
CVE-2026-125337.description: Winter CMS is a content management system built on the Laravel PHP framework. Prior to 1.2.14, the ImportExportController behavior applies userHasAccess() only to the import() and export() page actions, while Backend\Classes\Controller::execAjaxHandlers() dispatches onImport(), onImportLoadForm(), onImportLoadColumnSampleForm(), onExport(), and onExportLoadForm() before those gated actions run, and the separately reachable download() action also lacks the granular export check. Controllers without granular permission keys are unaffected because userHasAccess() is intentionally default-permissive. This issue is fixed in version 1.2.14.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

tcp: Fix potential UAF in reqsk_timer_handler().

When TCP socket migration fails at inet_ehash_insert() in
reqsk_timer_handler(), we jump to the no_ownership: label
and free the new reqsk immediately with __reqsk_free().

Thus, we must stop the new reqsk's timer before jumping to the
label, but the timer might be missed since the cited commit,
resulting in UAF.

As we are in the original reqsk's timer context, we can safely
call timer_delete_sync() for the new reqsk.

Let's pass false to __inet_csk_reqsk_queue_drop() to stop
the new reqsk's timer.

CVE-2026-99748.title: ksmbd: revert fsids on durable reconnect and replay failure
CVE-2026-99748.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ksmbd: revert fsids on durable reconnect and replay failure

On a durable handle reconnect or a request replay, smb2_open() switches
to the SMB user's fsids before calling ksmbd_vfs_getattr(). If that call
fails, the code jumps to err_out2 and skips ksmbd_revert_fsids() at
err_out1. The user's credentials then stay installed on the shared ksmbd
worker. Later work on that worker, including other users' requests, runs
with the first user's fsuid, fsgid and supplementary groups.
ksmbd_free_work_struct() also warns, because work->saved_cred is still
set.

Jump to err_out1 instead. No path is held at this point, so skipping the
path_put() at err_out is correct.
